_comment: GENERATION runtime config — connection + credentials + run scale ONLY. This file is NOT part of the frozen bundle and carries NO statistical parameter: every distribution/count lives in params.json (frozen) and every policy constant (approval_threshold, splitting_window_days) in _pipeline/config.json. Copy this file to gen_config.json and fill in the placeholders; gen_config.json is git-ignored because it holds passwords.

buyer._comment: Non-manager buyer: purchase.group_purchase_user, NOT group_purchase_manager. Above-threshold POs this user confirms must route to 'To Approve' — that routing is what makes the scenario-4 self-approval signal meaningful.

manager._comment: Purchase manager: purchase.group_purchase_manager. Approves above-threshold POs; also the actor for master-data setup and for the scenario-3 vendor-master tampering.

run._comment: scale: 'smoke' = ~30 POs with all 5 scenarios present, for the end-to-end rehearsal; 'full' = the frozen counts from params.json. The smoke scale scales counts DOWN proportionally; it never changes a distribution.
